workspace {
  model {
    user = person "User"
    system = softwareSystem "My System" {
      web = container "Web App"
      api = container "API"
      user -> web "Uses"
      web -> api "Calls"
    }
  }
  views {
    systemContext system "Context" {
      include *
      autoLayout
    }
    container system "Containers" {
      include *
      autoLayout
    }
  }
}
